programme.desc: Kisah para pelari maraton nasional yang ingin berlari lagi setelah pembebasan Korea, dan upaya mereka untuk berkompetisi dalam maraton internasional pertama mereka.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent Jun
programme.desc: While under the influence of alcohol, an unsuccessful comic book writer draws a comic about his life as a former NIS hitman, and runs into trouble when it gets posted online.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent Jun
programme.desc: Ketika berada di bawah pengaruh alkohol, seorang komikus gagal menggambar komik tentang kisah hidupnya sebagai mantan pembunuh bayaran NIS, dan ia mendapatkan masalah saat komik tersebut diterbitkan online.

programme.title: A Reason To Live
programme.desc: A female producer loses her fiancée in a hit and run accident and stands in the line of conflict.

programme.title: Bottom Of The Water
programme.desc: An evil spirit that can escape the water only by possessing a living person. The evil spirit of a child who died unjustly while waiting for his mother alone.

programme.title: Okay! Madam (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: A married couple unwittingly become involved in a rescue operation of a hijacked aircraft during their first-ever family trip abroad to Hawaii.

programme.title: Okay! Madam (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam operasi penyelamatan sebuah pesawat yang dibajak dalam perjalanan mereka menuju Hawaii.

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: After ten years in jail, Doohyun is released and wants nothing more than to live an ordinary life, but when his old partner kidnaps his daughter, the long-hidden Goblin inside him awakes.

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: Doo Hyeon yang dikenal dengan nama "Goblin" masuk penjara karena jatuh cinta pada Yeong Min yang membunuh bosnya. Setelah 10 tahun, Doo Hyeon dibebaskan dan telah menjalani kehidupan normal. Namun, dia harus menerima kenyataan bahwa Yeong Min telah memanfaatkan namanya "Goblin". Yeong Min bahkan menculik putrinya untuk tutup mulut. Doo Hyeon marah, melakukan balas dendam dan mengumumkan kembalinya "Goblin" yang asli.

programme.title: Room No. 7 (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Du-sik, the owner of the DVD room, and Tae-jung, a part-timer, confront each other to protect Room No. 7.

programme.title: Room No. 7 (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Du-sik, pemilik ruang DVD, dan Tae-jung, seorang pekerja paruh waktu, saling berhadapan untuk melindungi Kamar No. 7.

programme.title: My Puppy
programme.desc: A groom-to-be sets off with his friend to finding a new owner for his puppy.

programme.title: My Puppy
programme.desc: Seorang calon pengantin pria pergi bersama temannya guna mencari pemilik baru untuk anak anjingnya.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: Genius Mathematician defected from the North tried to hide his past eventually started teaching a student who gave up on Maths the right way to find the answer.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: Ahli Matematika jenius yang membelot dari Korea Utara berusaha menyembunyikan masa lalunya sampai akhirnya ia mulai mengajari seorang siswa yang menyerah pada Matematika hingga mampu menjawab soal.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five follows five strangers whose lives change dramatically after each receives an organ transplant from the same donor. Soon, they discover that the transplants have granted them extraordinary powers ranging from enhanced strength to unique supernatural abilities. While struggling to understand their new identities, the group becomes the target of a powerful and ambitious individual who seeks to obtain their abilities at any cost. Forced to work together despite their differences, the unlikely heroes embark on a thrilling adventure filled with action, humor, and teamwork as they fight to protect themselves and those around them.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Noryang: Deadly Sea
programme.desc: Winter of 1598, the story of Yi Sun-shin's last naval battle during the Japanese invasions of Korea that happened in the Noryang Strait.
